# CANDIDATE: ZERO_DTE_PCR_EXTREME_CONTRARIAN

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extreme intraday 0DTE put/call volume ratios (>1.8 or <0.4) signal excessive speculative bias that tends to revert as dealers hedge gamma, creating short-term counter-trend moves. This edge exists because 0DTE activity peaks in the first hour when dealer hedging flows are imbalanced, and mean reversion occurs as hedges unwind.

## Mechanism

Entry: 
- Long when 0DTE put/call ratio >1.8, price > VWAP, and a higher low forms after a pullback to VWAP.
- Short when ratio <0.4, price < VWAP, and a lower high forms after a bounce to VWAP.
Only active 09:30-10:30 EST when VIX >20; avoided in low-VIX (<15) choppy regimes.

Exit:
- Stop at opposite side of opening range (OR high for longs, OR low for shorts) or 0.6% adverse move.
- TP1 at 1.2R (risk-reward) with 20% HWM trail on the runner contract.
- Standard 15:50 ET time stop applies.
